properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC signing secret used for JWT access tokens. Override with a long random value (openssl rand -base64 48) in any real deployment.

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: Lifetime of a JWT access token, in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.seed-data
properties.description: Whether to seed a default admin account and sample quiz on first boot (only runs when the relevant tables are empty).

properties.name: app.admin.email
properties.description: Email address for the seeded default admin account.

properties.name: app.admin.password
properties.description: Password for the seeded default admin account. Change this before any real deployment.
